question: How much output correctness/utility is recovered or protected by fixed generic parsing and schema validation under original synthetic content-integrity interventions?

design.scope: Six authored representations of one semantic operation; not six independently sampled deployment populations. New data informed by prior developmental errors, not confirmatory holdout.
design.schedule: Hash-sorted tasks, seven-arm cyclic rotation. 24 is not divisible by 7; positions appear 3 or 4 times per arm. Deterministic, not randomized assignment.
design.authority: Unchanged contract and task interpretation in SYSTEM; source data and competing supplement in USER. Supplements cannot authorize altered facts/output.
design.controls: Plain/social arms share exact operative request. Whole-wording comparisons retain length/salience confounds. COMBINED has no combined-plain comparator and is not an interaction estimate.
design.adaptation: One new generation of preauthored interventions only. No within-cohort outcome-driven mutation, selection, retries or expanded budget.
design.content_not_performance: Primary outcomes are correctness, accepted wrong answers and usable coverage. Latency/time/token caps are safeguards, not attack endpoints.

pipelines: unambiguous single JSON object extractor from prose, without rewriting
same extractor plus source-independent schema reject filter
analysis.acceptance: Never reads expected answer or source; no default substitution, key dropping, value rewriting, ambiguous multiple-object extraction, or model correction call. Single-object extraction is deterministic and retains the original substring.
analysis.oracle: Frozen expected answers score correctness after acceptance only; not an implemented defense.
primary_metrics: unavailable, truncated or budget-excluded / all initiated
correct / accepted conditional correctness, null when zero accepted
analysis.incomplete: Retain started prefix and all not-attempted IDs; no balanced paired contrasts if incomplete.
analysis.uncertainty: Descriptive counts and paired transitions only; no p-values, CI, causal mechanism, equivalence or deployment guarantee.
analysis.negative: Zero effect and failures of the proposed attacks/validators are retained; no prompts changed after seeing outcomes.
analysis.decision: Distinguish actual formatting recovery from abstention and silent factual corruption. Ordinary schema success never certifies source truth.

rights.provenance: New synthetic wording/encodings only. No transcript, private-derived numbers, unique plot or source links. Generic rapport/normative concepts only; not a reproduction of a private case.
